description: A helper class to set up and manage the SQLite database for GPS location data, including creation, insertion, reading for a specific day, and deletion of entries.

classes.name: LocationDbHelper
classes.description: A SQLiteOpenHelper subclass for managing the location database, providing methods to create, upgrade, insert LocationEntry objects, read entries for a specific day, and delete entries.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a LocationEntry object into the database with fields day, longitude, latitude, and timestamp.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Retrieves a list of LocationEntry objects for a specified day based on a Calendar object, sorted chronologically.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes location entries for a specified day, either by day string or Calendar date.
